domain: Analytical and descriptive bibliography of the hand-press book — collation formulae, ideal-copy reconstruction, cancel leaves, stop-press variants, sophisticated copies, and the Hinman collator.
axioms: A copy is described by a formula that enumerates every gathering and leaf; anything the formula does not name is never examined, and the omission is invisible forever rather than eventually.
The authority for a comparison is an ideal copy reconstructed from many exemplars, never the single exemplar in hand and never a copy of unknown state.
Two copies bearing one imprint can differ leaf by leaf, because correction happens while the press runs; identity of imprint is not identity of sheets.

A cancellans is genuine paper and genuine type substituted for another leaf: it satisfies the formula exactly while carrying different words, so any rule stated as a surface form can be satisfied without being obeyed.
The imprint line is a claim by the printer and is evidence of nothing on its own; it is recorded, not believed.

A sophisticated copy — made up from parts of several copies so that it looks complete — is the copy most likely to pass inspection, so a comparison that supplies both of its own sides proves only self-agreement.
Collation by superimposition detects change only within the pages placed under the machine; coverage and correctness are separate properties and coverage is the one that is silently absent.
failure_mode: Reasons about a fixed artifact at rest, so it systematically misses timing: how often a comparison runs, whether the window between publication and inspection is itself the fault, and whether the reference moved during the examination.
Has no vocabulary for a human reader who stops reading; alarm cadence, fatigue, and the standing-failure downgrade are outside the discipline and will be under-weighted or ignored.
Treats completeness as the supreme virtue, so it over-values whole-tree comparison and under-costs the finding-list noise a wider surface produces.

Cannot judge whether a value is stale, only whether two artifacts differ; questions of precedence between live and carried identifiers read to it as questions about which copy, not about which moment.
Assumes the examiner is a trained human with unlimited attention per copy, so it under-weights runtime bounds — a 60 s fetch, a 300 s check, a fail-open hook path.
